label: PF Backlog 575
title: Defect: shared lease authority (BI-PF-1261) is active OFFLINE/unit-tests (ignores PF_OFFLINE) -> non-hermetic assignment tests + stray pf-leases refs; blocks deliveries
body: BI-PF-1261 added a shared git-CAS lease authority (core/job_manager.lease_acquire). Its mode defaults to strict and does NOT honor PF_OFFLINE, so unit tests (test_assignments_api / test_assignment_dedup, which set PF_OFFLINE=1) write leases to the shared authority -> pollution ('already leased by w1' across runs) and stray pf-leases/pf-id-counter refs (pushed). In the delivery lane this manifests as flaky/timeout verification. RCCA: offline implies no remote authority -> lease mode must be OFF when PF_OFFLINE=1.

objective: Make the lease authority hermetic offline/for unit tests: when PF_OFFLINE is set, force lease mode off (local) so tests are isolated and no shared refs are written.
acceptance_criteria: PF_OFFLINE=1 => lease mode off (local); no shared-authority writes
no stray pf-leases ref created during tests
out_of_scope: removing the shared authority for online use
cleaning the existing pf-leases ref (separate ops action)
approach: In _lease_mode(): if PF_OFFLINE is truthy -> return 'off'. Tests/offline then use the local path; online keeps the shared authority.
